quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Nicolas Batum's retirement and his impact on the Clippers and Sixers
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if y'all know history, but me and Nico, we came under 19, USA 18 versus France.
quotes.quote: It made me sad a little bit, I ain't going to front y'all. Nicolas Batum retiring. It made me sad because, you know, I don't know if y'all know history, but me and Nico, we came under 19, USA 18 versus France. That's why I first met Nico. Obviously, we were teammates in the Clippers, we were teammates in Philly. You talk about, and I like to pride myself on working hard, I get to the gym super early, he already there finishing up. I want y'all to understand the type of teammate he was. I'm talking about first in the gym, very high IQ basketball player. Defensively, you can put him everywhere. Very, very, very good role model, vet, locker room teammate. Even more better human being.
